Our Businesses
Our Global Businesses
At Sunstar, our Consumer and Industrial businesses lead the way in delivering innovative solutions that enhance quality of life worldwide. From oral care to adhesives and core materials, we are committed to shaping a healthier, more sustainable future. With a strong global footprint and operational hubs in key markets, we put our purpose into action every day—improving well-being through science, technology, and a forward-looking strategy.
Style
Full Width
Our Consumer Business
Sunstar’s Consumer Business delivers innovative solutions in the Oral Care sector, catering to the needs of both consumers and oral care professionals worldwide. Our extensive portfolio features toothpaste, mouthwash, toothbrushes, interdental products, and advanced dental treatments, all designed to promote oral health and overall well-being.
Consumer Oral Care
Sustaining a healthy body through a healthy mouth
Sunstar is a pioneer in championing the idea that the state of one’s oral health has a deep connection to the health of the whole body. Through our trusted brands – GUM, Butler, and Ora2 – we provide oral care solutions that help consumers achieve and maintain better oral health. From preventing cavities and gum disease to enhancing daily hygiene routines, Sunstar bridges the gap between oral care and general health.
Consumer Oral Care Solutions
Professional Oral Care
For over 30 years, Sunstar has been dedicated to supporting oral care professionals. Sunstar solutions address a wide range of dental needs, from prevention to treatment. Developed in close collaboration with dental experts, Sunstar products empower practitioners to enhance patient outcomes and promote overall health.
Professional Oral Care Solutions
Food and Beauty Brands
Strengthen the body to live a healthy & beautiful life
Sunstar offers a diverse range of unique health food and beauty products that are designed to support a healthy, vibrant lifestyle. Our brands provide innovative solutions that help people everywhere live healthy and full lives.

Driving Industrial Excellence with Innovative Solutions
Sunstar’s Industrial Business specializes in developing advanced adhesives and sealants for the Automotive, Construction, and Electronics sectors through our Chemical Division. Our Material Core Division manufactures and supplies a wide range of precision-engineered metal components. Additionally, we deliver cutting-edge solutions to improve indoor air quality in diverse environments.

Chemical Division
The Chemical Division at Sunstar drives innovation with high-performance sealants and adhesives for automotive, construction, and electronics industries. Our solutions are designed to enhance vehicle durability and efficiency, create safe and sustainable living spaces, and address the unique needs of diverse sectors. Backed by years of expertise and a commitment to quality, we provide customized products that improve the driving experience, promote healthier environments, and support advanced technological applications.
Adhesives and Sealant Innovations
Material Core Division
The Material Core Division specializes in superior motorcycle and automotive parts that enhance the driving experience for enthusiasts worldwide. Our precision-engineered components deliver outstanding performance, safety and durability. With over half a century of innovation, we continue to lead the industry in driving excellence.
Precision-Engineered Material Core
Indoor Air Quality
Sunstar's eScience solutions are focused on enhancing indoor air quality, benefiting hospitals, homes, and various other spaces. The QAIS-air-01, designed for hospitals, nurseries, and other healthcare facilities, is a next-generation photocatalytic deodorization and sterilization system that eliminates harmful bacteria and viruses from the air. Our product range also includes practical solutions like bedding-care mists, house dust suppression sprays, and specialized detergents, designed to support a cleaner, more comfortable environments.
eScience Technologies for Better Air Quality
